intlcost.title: SDSU - Estimated Costs for International Students

stats.notes: Figures from IPEDS, the US government's college data (fall 2023 entering class). College Navigator's fall 2024 figures: 7,287 applicants, 98% admitted, 34% of admitted enrolled; ACT composite 19/22/25 (75% submitted), SAT ERW 530/570/610, SAT Math 530/560/630 (2% submitted). SDSU's only readable public Common Data Set is 2021-22 (newer years are listed but not linked), so GPA, residency and international applicant splits are not added. IPEDS reported no international first-year applicants. Undergraduate enrollment 10,177 and 307 nonresident-alien undergraduates are from IPEDS (fall 2023).

cost.notes: SDSU estimated annual cost for international undergraduates (page does not name the year): tuition and fees $16,284, living expenses $9,814, other $3,697, total $29,795; the page warns of annual increases up to 5%. SDSU's 2026-27 cost-of-attendance page for domestic nonresidents shows tuition and fees $13,479 and housing/food $11,024
